0.0.n: Part of 夜更かし, a compound meaning staying up late.

0.1.n: The noun-form of 更かす combines with 夜 to make 夜更かし; treat them as one word.

0.2.n: Placed after an activity to state a rule; です is omitted in this compact list.

0.4.n: 外での describes the drinking parties as taking place outside, away from home.

0.5.n: Marks where the drinking parties take place.

0.6.n: Links 外で to 飲み会, letting the location describe the parties.

0.7.n: Refers to social gatherings where people drink alcohol.

0.8.n: Joins 飲み会 and アルコール as two prohibited things.

0.9.n: An English loanword written in katakana.

0.10.n: Adds drinking parties and alcohol to the earlier prohibition.

0.11.n: Applies to both 飲み会 and アルコール.

0.13.n: SNS is the common Japanese abbreviation used for social networking services.

0.14.n: Marks social media as the topic of this rule.

0.15.n: Uses the 24-hour clock: 24時 is midnight at the end of the day.

0.16.n: Marks midnight as the cutoff for social media use.

0.18.n: Refers here to broadcasting content online.

0.19.n: Introduces streaming as the next topic in the list.

0.20.n: Combines with だけ to form できるだけ, meaning as much as possible.

0.21.n: After できる, it indicates the fullest extent possible, rather than only.

0.22.n: Plain form of する; here it states a rule about doing streams, rather than describing a current action.

1.0.n: A polite acknowledgment showing acceptance of what was just said.

2.0.n: An English loanword written in katakana.

2.1.n: Links オーディション to 時 to specify which occasion.

2.2.n: オーディションの時 sets the scene as during the audition.

2.3.n: Casual contraction of 言っていた, recalling something the listener said previously.

2.4.n: Adds a reminding tone to the speaker's recollection.

2.5.n: Seeks agreement; together, よね asks the listener to confirm a remembered fact.

2.7.n: With の頃, refers to the time when the listener was a child.

2.8.n: Links 子ども to 頃 to describe the period of childhood.

2.9.n: Refers to a period of life rather than a precise date.

2.10.n: Marks childhood as the starting point of the admiration.

2.11.n: Refers to pop entertainers, often singers and dancers, rather than religious figures.

2.12.n: Marks idols as the target of 憧れる, the feeling of admiration or aspiration.

2.13.n: 憧れる in て-form plus きた shows admiration continuing from childhood up to the relevant present.

2.14.n: Casual quotation marker referring back to 言ってた; it identifies what the listener said.

0.lit: Staying up late prohibited; outside drinking parties and alcohol also prohibited; social media until midnight; streaming do as much possible.
0.tip: This compact rule list omits full sentence endings; the final する also states a rule.

1.tip: はい can acknowledge instructions, not just answer a yes-or-no question.

2.lit: At audition time, you said, right? That since childhood you have admired idols.
2.tip: The final って marks a quote placed after 言ってた, giving the content of what was said.
